title: Software Engineering Intern 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Experience in C++, Java, Python, or Go, and Data Structures/Algorithms.
description: Google's Software Engineering Internship offers students the opportunity to work on complex real-world projects, collaborate with full-time engineers, and gain hands-on technical experience.

title: Chevening Fully Funded Master's Scholarship
eligibility: International students with at least 2 years of work experience applying for eligible UK Master's degrees.
qualification: Undergraduate degree equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree in the UK.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master's degrees in any subject at any UK university.

title: Junior Software Engineer
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with up to 2 years of software development experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience.
description: Join Microsoft's engineering team to build scalable cloud services, AI tools, and consumer-facing software applications that impact millions worldwide.

title: Remote Web Front-End Engineer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with experience building modern web applications using vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and modern frameworks.
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React or Vue, and responsive web design.
description: Canonical is seeking a remote Front-End Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain websites and web interfaces across Ubuntu and Canonical ecosystem products.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ currently enrolled in high school, college, or university globally.
qualification: Student teams building innovative technology projects utilizing Microsoft Azure.
description: The Imagine Cup is Microsoft's global student technology competition where students create impactful solutions using technology, AI, and cloud services.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide interested in learning computer science concepts.
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that teaches students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
